NEW_FAULTS: The infamous one, and it earns it. This is the Getrag 6DCT250 dry dual-clutch (Fiesta/Focus/EcoSport). The core defect is the dry clutch and its control: violent shuddering and juddering on take-off, hesitation and lurching at low speed, and repeated TCM (transmission control module) failures. A second failure mode is the input-shaft seals weeping transmission fluid onto the clutch friction faces, which contaminates them and causes slip/shudder — clutches then need replacing at low mileage. It generated class-action lawsuits and buybacks in the US and Australia and is widely regarded as one of the worst mass-market transmissions ever fitted. For your advisory: a hard avoid for a city buyer, and any DPS6 car needs documented clutch/TCM history.
